call_points.text: FY27 disbursement growth guided at 22-23% and AUM growth at 17-18%.
Branch network expanded to 440 across 15 states.
Home loan disbursements grew 38% YoY; management aims to regain home loan market share.
Cost of funds improved 38 bps YoY; PLR cut 10 bps in June, cumulative 25 bps since March 2026.
Net worth ₹5,220 Cr; CAR 44.66%, well above regulatory requirements.
RBI circular on asset classification of repossessed assets is under evaluation; no quantified impact yet.
Productivity per field resource targeted to double from ₹8-10 lakh to ₹20-22 lakh over two years.
Management aims to consistently deliver 20%-plus AUM growth, outperforming the industry.
Spreads are expected to be maintained above 5% through risk-adjusted pricing.

operating_notes.text: Mr. Sachinderpalsingh Jitendrasingh Bhinder resigned as MD & CEO effective April 20, 2026.
Mr. Manu Yeshpal Singh appointed as CEO effective April 21, 2026, and MD subject to RBI and shareholder approvals.

Branch network stood at 440 across 15 states as of June 2026.
42% of borrowings are linked to external benchmarks and 34% to sub-3-month MCLR, enabling re-pricing of 76% of borrowings.
Branch network expanded to 443 across 15 states in Q2FY27.
AUM crossed ₹25,000 Cr milestone, serving over 3.8 lakh families across 443 branches.

timeline.summary: Aavas Financiers announced the resignation of MD & CEO Sachinderpalsingh Bhinder and the appointment of Manu Yeshpal Singh as his successor on April 20, 2026.
Aavas Financiers received final [ICRA]AAA(SO) rating for ₹495.61 Cr pass-through certificates.
Aavas Financiers Limited will hold an earnings conference call on May 05, 2026, at 05:30 PM (IST) to discuss Q4FY26 and FY26 performance, chaired by **SAURABH SHARMA (ACS-60350)**.
Aavas Financiers reported Q4 FY26 PAT of ₹181.67 Cr; and proposed a ₹9,000 Cr NCD fundraising limit.
Aavas Financiers reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹181.7 Cr, up 18% YoY, and AUM of ₹23,452 Cr.
Aavas Financiers reported Q4 FY26 PAT of ₹182 Cr, up 18% YoY, with AUM reaching ₹23,452 Cr.
Aavas Financiers Limited’s Management, led by **SAURABH SHARMA (ACS: 60350)**, schedules investor/analyst meets on May 29, June 1, 5, and 9, 2026, at Mumbai.

On July 21, 2026, Aavas Financiers held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting 23% YoY PAT growth to ₹171 Cr, 15.4% AUM growth to ₹23,930 Cr, and guiding FY27 AUM growth of 17-18% with spread expected below 5%.

Aavas Financiers Limited will hold an earnings call on October 26, 2026, at 6:30 PM (IST) led by **Manu Singh (MD & CEO)**, **Ripudaman Bandral (CBO)**, **Ghanshyam Gupta (CFO)**, and **Rakesh Shinde (Head of IR)** to discuss Q2FY27 results.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹736.3 Cr (+10.4% YoY), net profit ₹181.52 Cr (+10.7% YoY).
Aavas Financiers H1FY27 PAT grows 16.4% YoY to ₹352.8 Cr on robust AUM expansion

Aavas Financiers announced changes to its board and senior management, accepting resignations of Independent Director Soumya Rajan and Head of Internal Audit R. Venkatesh while appointing Anjali Seth and Bharat Thakkar respectively.
Aavas Financiers obtained an IRDAI Certificate of Registration to act as a Corporate Agent effective from December 8, 2026.
Aavas Financiers crossed ₹25,000 Cr in Assets Under Management (AUM).
